prompt: Leave the voicemail Dad leaves after hearing about your promotion. He is very proud. He will not say that.
response:
*[beep]*

Yeah, hey, it's Dad.

Your mother told me about the... the job thing. The promotion. So. That's the news, I guess. She's been on the phone all morning telling everybody, your Aunt Carol, the Hendersons, the whole street probably knows by now. You know how she gets.

Anyway. I was thinking — you're gonna want to look at your 401k contributions now, with the new salary. Bump that up before you get used to spending it. They tell you that? Probably not. Nobody tells you that stuff.

*[pause]*

Also your check engine light — is that still on? Because if you're driving more for this new position, you can't be riding around with that thing lit up. Take it to Ray's. Tell him I sent you. Don't go to the dealership, they'll rob you blind.

*[longer pause]*

Your grandfather worked at the same plant for thirty-one years and never once got called into the office for anything good. So.

*[clears throat]*

Anyway. Your mother wants you to come for dinner Sunday. She's making the roast. The one you like. That was her idea, the roast.

Okay. Call your mother back, she's driving me nuts.

*[pause, like he's about to hang up, doesn't]*

...Don't let 'em work you too hard over there. They give you the title so they can give you the hours. Just — you know. Watch that.

Okay. Bye.

*[click]*
